guhwinter.npc.praat.anthony.kerst.1: Tonight we do 'gourmet'. Everybody gets a tiny pannetje. A TINY pan! I have never been so blij.
guhwinter.npc.praat.anthony.kerst.2: Opa Jochum is very nice. What? Wijnand? Oh no. Sorry, opa. Sorry, Wijnand.
guhwinter.npc.praat.anthony.kerst.3: *click* The tree! *click* The baubles! *click* The tree again! My camera is vol. I'm buying a new one.
guhwinter.npc.praat.anthony.kerst.4: In Guhmerika we eat turkey. Here I make my own little... how do you say... pannetje. With a little egg! Prachtig!
guhwinter.npc.praat.anthony.oudjaar.1: Oliebollen! It's a donut, but... rounder? With raisins? And sugar snow? I've already had zes.
guhwinter.npc.praat.anthony.oudjaar.2: Lin says 'never fried' and she bakes them in a little machine. Bertus! Bertus is the best kok. *click*
guhwinter.npc.praat.anthony.oudjaar.3: My good resolution: learn Dutch. 'Hagelslag'. 'Pindakaas'. 'Nyeg'. I'm already almost fluent.
guhwinter.npc.praat.anthony.oudjaar.4: Next year I come back. Volgend jaar! With a bigger camera. And a bigger maag.
guhwinter.npc.praat.anthony.sint.1: Why is the bishop on a boat?? Is this normal? Rins says this is normaal.
guhwinter.npc.praat.anthony.sint.2: Pepernoten! Little cookies, very hard, and you throw them at people? What a country. I love it.
guhwinter.npc.praat.anthony.sint.3: *click* Sorry, I take a foto of everything. That horse. That roof. You. *click*
guhwinter.npc.praat.anthony.sint.4: In Guhmerika we have Santa. He has a sleigh. Your Sint has a boat and a horse and he got verdwaald. Much more spannend!
guhwinter.npc.praat.anthony.sint.5: You put a shoe by the... schoorsteen? And then candy comes in your shoe? Your SHOE? Okay. Okay. Ik doe mee.
guhwinter.npc.praat.corine.kerst.1: Gourmet night only starts when everyone is seated. You too, sweetie. There's always a spot.
guhwinter.npc.praat.corine.kerst.2: Lin gets her own little pan without oil. I tied a bow around it. So she feels welcome.
guhwinter.npc.praat.corine.kerst.3: Anthony asked why we eat out of mini pans. I said: sweetie, that's gourmet night. He took four photos of it.
guhwinter.npc.praat.corine.kerst.4: My mother is sitting by the fire. She's been knitting one scarf for three hours. It's already four metres long. A piece for everyone.
guhwinter.npc.praat.corine.oudjaar.1: The batter has been rising since this morning. My secret? Love. And yeast. Mostly yeast.
guhwinter.npc.praat.corine.oudjaar.2: Lin's air fryer oliebollen are tastier than mine. I'm very proud of her. And a tiny bit jealous.
guhwinter.npc.praat.corine.oudjaar.3: My resolution: more time for myself. But first let me bake you an apple turnover.
guhwinter.npc.praat.corine.oudjaar.4: Wear your scarf when you go outside, sweetie. Even if you're a guh. Especially if you're a guh.
guhwinter.npc.praat.corine.sint.1: Hello sweetie! Have you had hot chocolate yet? No? Then you get two.
guhwinter.npc.praat.corine.sint.2: My children are all grown up, but at Sinterklaas they're little again. Especially Joost.
guhwinter.npc.praat.corine.sint.3: The Sint looks tired from his trip. I gave him a blanket and some soup. Mum things.
guhwinter.npc.praat.corine.sint.4: Suus asked if I knew what Joost has in his bag for her. I said: pepernoten, sweetie. She looked a little disappointed.
guhwinter.npc.praat.daan.kerst.1: We celebrate Christmas just the four of us. But a quick stop at the pond by Grandpa and Grandma's is always fine.
guhwinter.npc.praat.daan.kerst.2: One more round, Liv? You said that twenty rounds ago too.
guhwinter.npc.praat.daan.kerst.3: Finn wants to skate the Elftocht when he's older. I said: first one round of the pond without falling. He fell.
guhwinter.npc.praat.daan.kerst.4: Grandpa Wijnand gave Liv a little bell for her sled. Now we'll never get her off it. The sled, I mean.
guhwinter.npc.praat.daan.oudjaar.1: The kids can stay up till midnight. Finn is planning to stay awake. Finn will be asleep by nine.
guhwinter.npc.praat.daan.oudjaar.2: My resolution: when Liv says 'one more round', really only one more round. I'm not going to make it.
guhwinter.npc.praat.daan.oudjaar.3: Oliebollen with the kids is mostly cleaning up powdered sugar. But very cosy powdered sugar.
guhwinter.npc.praat.daan.oudjaar.4: Happy new year, chonkje! Here's to a year full of sled rides and skating.
guhwinter.npc.praat.daan.sint.1: Go Finn, well done! Look at him skate. He gets that from me. The falling too.
guhwinter.npc.praat.daan.sint.2: Liv only wants to ride the sled. I'm the engine. A very tired engine.
guhwinter.npc.praat.daan.sint.3: Kim and I have the surprises for the kids ready. Finn gets a cardboard skate. Liv a cardboard sled. I get some rest. I hope.
guhwinter.npc.praat.daan.sint.4: When I was as small as Finn, the Sint just arrived in Goringuhm. Now he's in the Guhmension. Kids these days are lucky.
guhwinter.npc.praat.evi.kerst.1: In Japan you eat chicken and strawberry cake at Christmas. Here we do gourmet. Both wahoog.
guhwinter.npc.praat.evi.kerst.2: I drew a kitsune for the tree. Wearing a Santa hat. Cultural exchange!
guhwinter.npc.praat.evi.kerst.3: Dad and Mum covered the whole house in lights. It looks like Tokyo. A very small, very cosy Tokyo.
guhwinter.npc.praat.evi.kerst.4: Grandpa's name is Wijnand. Joost keeps saying Jochum. In Japan you bow when you get someone's name wrong. Joost is bowing a lot today.
guhwinter.npc.praat.evi.oudjaar.1: My resolution: go to Japan three times this year. Niels wants to go by train. I showed him the sea on the map.
guhwinter.npc.praat.evi.oudjaar.2: In Japan they ring a bell 108 times on New Year's Eve. We eat 108 oliebollen. About the same.
guhwinter.npc.praat.evi.oudjaar.3: Akemashite omedetou! That's Japanese for 'happy new year'. And 'wahoog' is guh for everything.
guhwinter.npc.praat.evi.oudjaar.4: Lin's air fryer oliebollen are just like mochi. Soft and round, and they make you happy.
guhwinter.npc.praat.evi.sint.1: At the guhmeentehuis I hand out passports. Ozochonk doesn't have one yet. How will he ever get to Japan?
guhwinter.npc.praat.evi.sint.2: In Japan they don't put out a shoe, but Niels and I do it anyway. With an onigiri in it. Just in case.
guhwinter.npc.praat.evi.sint.3: Sinterklaas is basically an anime hero. Long cloak, dramatic entrance, a loyal animal companion. Nyeg, I can totally see it.
guhwinter.npc.praat.evi.sint.4: Niels says the Sint should've come by train. He says that about everything. Even about my bike.
guhwinter.npc.praat.finn.kerst.1: A pirouette! ...Almost. Let me practise a bit more.
guhwinter.npc.praat.finn.kerst.2: Great-grandpa Wijnand says he once skated the Elftocht. Twice! Or was it the pond? He doesn't remember.
guhwinter.npc.praat.finn.kerst.3: I made a drawing of myself for the tree. Skating. Really fast. You only see streaks.
guhwinter.npc.praat.finn.oudjaar.1: I'm staying up till midnight tonight! I'm not tired at all. *yawn*
guhwinter.npc.praat.finn.oudjaar.2: My resolution: a real pirouette. And never fall again. And a dog.
guhwinter.npc.praat.finn.oudjaar.3: Oliebollen are just like skaters. They roll everywhere. Mostly off your plate.
guhwinter.npc.praat.finn.sint.1: Look! Look! I'm skating with no hands! ...I always skate with no hands. Guhs have paws.
guhwinter.npc.praat.finn.sint.2: I'm going to ask the Sint if Ozochonk can skate too. Horses can do anything.
guhwinter.npc.praat.finn.sint.3: I'm six. Nearly seven. Well, six. But a big six.
guhwinter.npc.praat.joost.kerst.1: Niels and I fetched the Christmas tree. Niels wanted to take the train. The tree didn't.
guhwinter.npc.praat.joost.kerst.2: Will you hang a drawing in the tree too? I drew Suus. She asked why I didn't draw a ring with it. Strange question.
guhwinter.npc.praat.joost.kerst.3: Gourmet night! The best part of Christmas is filling your own little pan. I put carpaccio in it. As a tribute.
guhwinter.npc.praat.joost.kerst.4: Grandpa is here! Grandpa Jo... Wijnand. Grandpa Wijnand. Wahoog, nearly got it right.
guhwinter.npc.praat.joost.oudjaar.1: Oliebollen! I'm only having twelve this year. Good resolution. Well, thirteen.
guhwinter.npc.praat.joost.oudjaar.2: My resolution: get the carpaccio streak at La Cubanita to twenty. Suus says she has a different resolution for me. She won't say which.
guhwinter.npc.praat.joost.oudjaar.3: Lin bakes hers in an air fryer. I laughed. Then I tasted one. I'm not laughing anymore. I'm eating.
guhwinter.npc.praat.joost.oudjaar.4: Happy new year in advance, chonkje! Here's to a year full of cuddles and wahoog.
guhwinter.npc.praat.joost.sint.1: Nyeg! Welcome to the Winterplein. Mum already made hot chocolate. Three pans. Just in case.
guhwinter.npc.praat.joost.sint.2: The Sint got lost? Took a wrong turn at Slot Loevestijn. Happens to the best of us. Well, the best Sint.
guhwinter.npc.praat.joost.sint.3: Suus and I have a ten-carpaccio streak at La Cubanita. Ten! You don't just break that for a steamboat.
guhwinter.npc.praat.joost.sint.4: Have you signed up in the Big Book yet? Drawing lots is the best thing of the whole year. After carpaccio.
guhwinter.npc.praat.joost.sint.5: Suus keeps asking if I have something small and shiny for her. I gave her a pepernoot. That's a bit shiny too.
guhwinter.npc.praat.kim.kerst.1: Look at those little ones. Rosy cheeks, cold paws. Hot chocolate in a bit.
guhwinter.npc.praat.kim.kerst.2: We celebrate Christmas at home, just the four of us, but this pond is simply too lovely to skip.
guhwinter.npc.praat.kim.kerst.3: Finn asked if the ducks here celebrate Christmas too. I said: I'm sure they do, sweetie. With tiny little pans.
guhwinter.npc.praat.kim.kerst.4: Liv wanted a Santa hat for her sled. I knitted one. Now the sled is warmer than me.
guhwinter.npc.praat.kim.oudjaar.1: My resolution: skate with Finn more often. Even though I'm not as good as him. Not nearly.
guhwinter.npc.praat.kim.oudjaar.2: Liv ate her first oliebol. More powdered sugar ended up on her than in her. So cute.
guhwinter.npc.praat.kim.oudjaar.3: At midnight we hold the little ones for a moment and look at the sky together. Best moment of the year.
guhwinter.npc.praat.kim.oudjaar.4: Happy new year, chonkje. Take an oliebol for the road. Or two.
guhwinter.npc.praat.kim.sint.1: Finn has been practising all day for the Sint. He wants to show he can do a pirouette. He can almost do a pirouette.
guhwinter.npc.praat.kim.sint.2: Liv made a drawing for the Sint. It's a horse. Or a cloud. She says it's both.
guhwinter.npc.praat.kim.sint.3: We're our own little family, but of course we drop by for Sinterklaas. Pepernoten are for everyone.
guhwinter.npc.praat.kim.sint.4: Daan has been pushing the sled for an hour. He says it's good for his fitness. He's a bit out of breath.
guhwinter.npc.praat.krijn.kerst.1: My father is here! Grandpa Wijnand. Joost introduced him as Jochum. I truly have no idea where that came from.
guhwinter.npc.praat.krijn.kerst.2: The gourmet set is out of the cupboard. Sixteen little pans. I counted them. Twice.
guhwinter.npc.praat.krijn.kerst.3: I put the star on top of the tree myself. On tiptoe. On a chair. On another chair.
guhwinter.npc.praat.krijn.kerst.4: Christmas with the whole family. That's what I wait for all year. Well, that and the oliebollen.
guhwinter.npc.praat.krijn.oudjaar.1: At midnight we all sing 'Happy New Year'. Off-key. But with a lot of love.
guhwinter.npc.praat.krijn.oudjaar.2: My resolution: clean the gutter. It's been my resolution for eleven years. It's a tradition.
guhwinter.npc.praat.krijn.oudjaar.3: Powdered sugar on your oliebol, powdered sugar on your snout, powdered sugar on the dog. We don't have a dog. It's on there anyway.
guhwinter.npc.praat.krijn.oudjaar.4: What a year, chonkje. Lovely that you were here. Come again next year!
guhwinter.npc.praat.krijn.sint.1: Welcome, welcome! Come in, warm your paws. Our door is always open. Except when there's a draught.
guhwinter.npc.praat.krijn.sint.2: Five kids, a square full of guests and now the Sint as well. Cosy! Corine, do we have enough chairs?
guhwinter.npc.praat.krijn.sint.3: The Sint can stay as long as he likes. I've already made up the guest room. And put out a bucket for Ozochonk.
guhwinter.npc.praat.krijn.sint.4: Go ahead and put your shoe by our chimney. It's extra wide. Just in case.
guhwinter.npc.praat.liek.kerst.1: The Christmas walk around the pond is my favourite. You never know what you'll run into. Wahoog, who knows!
guhwinter.npc.praat.liek.kerst.2: Mum Corine has eight kinds of sauce for gourmet night. Eight! I tasted them all. For science.
guhwinter.npc.praat.liek.kerst.3: Lin doesn't want anything fried on the table. Not even a croquette. I respect that. I secretly eat her croquette.
guhwinter.npc.praat.liek.kerst.4: I drew the whole family for the tree. Everyone is a circle with ears. Recognisable, right?
guhwinter.npc.praat.liek.oudjaar.1: My resolution: hug a guh every day who isn't expecting it. You're the first. Hug!
guhwinter.npc.praat.liek.oudjaar.2: Lin bakes them in an air fryer and they really ARE the best. I'm not saying that because she's my girlfriend. Well, a little.
guhwinter.npc.praat.liek.oudjaar.3: Are you writing a resolution on the board too? Everyone can read them. So don't write down secrets. Or do.
guhwinter.npc.praat.liek.oudjaar.4: Fireworks scare me, oliebollen don't. That's why I'm standing here. By the oliebollen.
guhwinter.npc.praat.liek.sint.1: Welcome! Mind the ice, it's slipperier than it looks. I tested it. With my bottom.
guhwinter.npc.praat.liek.sint.2: Lin and I decorated the whole square. Well, Lin decorated. I held the ladder and said 'pretty!'.
guhwinter.npc.praat.liek.sint.3: My nose ring sparkles so nicely in the lantern light. Suus keeps asking how you get a ring like that. Suspiciously often.
guhwinter.npc.praat.liek.sint.4: Drawing lots! I hope I draw someone who likes cute things. Cute is all I can do.
guhwinter.npc.praat.lin.kerst.1: Gourmet night is safe. It's cooking on a little hot plate. Nobody deep-fries anything. Right? RIGHT?
guhwinter.npc.praat.lin.kerst.2: Why I don't eat anything fried? The churro incident. That's all I'll say. There was a lot of sugar and a lot of tears.
guhwinter.npc.praat.lin.kerst.3: I drew a reindeer for the tree. Liek says it looks like a guh. Everything looks like a guh, Liek.
guhwinter.npc.praat.lin.kerst.4: I really hope we see a special bird at the pond. A kingfisher! Or... something even more special.
guhwinter.npc.praat.lin.oudjaar.1: Everyone deep-fries their oliebollen. Not me. I brought my air fryer. His name is Bertus.
guhwinter.npc.praat.lin.oudjaar.2: The churro incident shaped me. Now I bake everything in the air fryer and it's fantastic. Wahoog, Bertus!
guhwinter.npc.praat.lin.oudjaar.3: My resolution: never deep-fry again. I had that one last year too. It's going really well.
guhwinter.npc.praat.lin.oudjaar.4: Have a taste! An air fryer oliebol. Crispy, fluffy, no incidents. Nyeg.
guhwinter.npc.praat.lin.sint.1: Pepernoten are baked. Not fried. That's why I trust them.
guhwinter.npc.praat.lin.sint.2: Liek and I put up the lights. I fell off the ladder three times. Liek caught me twice.
guhwinter.npc.praat.lin.sint.3: A steamboat in the Guhmension. I've seen stranger things this year. Mostly at the kermis. We don't talk about that.
guhwinter.npc.praat.lin.sint.4: For my lootje I'm building something really cute. With flowers. No deep fryer. Never a deep fryer.
guhwinter.npc.praat.liv.kerst.1: My sled has a hat. Mummy knitted it. Now it's not cold.
guhwinter.npc.praat.liv.kerst.2: Great-grandpa gave me a little bell! Jingle! Jingle! Jingle!
guhwinter.npc.praat.liv.kerst.3: I made a drawing. It's a Christmas tree. Or a horsey. It's both.
guhwinter.npc.praat.liv.oudjaar.1: Powdered sugar! It's snowing on my oliebol!
guhwinter.npc.praat.liv.oudjaar.2: I'm staying up till twelve too. Just like Finn. ...What's twelve?
guhwinter.npc.praat.liv.oudjaar.3: Daddy, one more round! It's a new year, so it doesn't count.
guhwinter.npc.praat.liv.sint.1: Daddy! One more round! One more round!
guhwinter.npc.praat.liv.sint.2: I'm almost four. That's very big. Bigger than three.
guhwinter.npc.praat.liv.sint.3: Horsey! Can I ride the horsey? No? Then the sled. Daddy, push!
guhwinter.npc.praat.marrie.kerst.1: Nice and cosy by the fire, chonkje. Warm paws, warm heart. That's how Christmas should be.
guhwinter.npc.praat.marrie.kerst.2: I've known Wijnand for sixty years. He was called Wijnand back then too. I don't know where this Jochum comes from.
guhwinter.npc.praat.marrie.kerst.3: Anthony took a photo of my knitting. And of my teacup. And of me. He's a sweet boy.
guhwinter.npc.praat.marrie.kerst.4: I drew all my grandchildren for the tree. It became a long row of circles. All equally sweet.
guhwinter.npc.praat.marrie.oudjaar.1: My resolution: even more scarves. There's always someone who's cold.
guhwinter.npc.praat.marrie.oudjaar.2: At midnight everyone gets a kiss from Grandma. You too. There's no escaping it.
guhwinter.npc.praat.marrie.oudjaar.3: Oliebollen are just like grandchildren. Round, sweet, and you can never have too many.
guhwinter.npc.praat.marrie.oudjaar.4: Do you know the best thing about New Year's Eve? That everyone's here. That's enough, chonkje.
guhwinter.npc.praat.marrie.sint.1: Come and sit with Grandma, chonkje. Would you like a pepernoot? I always keep a few in my apron.
guhwinter.npc.praat.marrie.sint.2: In my day the Sint just came over the roof. Now he gets lost in a boat. Everything changes.
guhwinter.npc.praat.marrie.sint.3: I'm knitting a scarf for everyone. For Ozochonk too. His will be a bit longer.
guhwinter.npc.praat.marrie.sint.4: Corine used to be so scared of the Sint. Now she makes him soup. Children grow up so fast.
guhwinter.npc.praat.niels.kerst.1: The Christmas tree didn't fit on the train. The train wasn't the problem. The tree was the problem.
guhwinter.npc.praat.niels.kerst.2: I drew a train for the tree. With a Christmas tree inside it. That's how it should have gone.
guhwinter.npc.praat.niels.kerst.3: My Christmas wish: a rail link from the Guhmension to Goringuhm. Then the Sint would never have got lost either.
guhwinter.npc.praat.niels.kerst.4: Gourmet night is basically a shunting yard. All those little pans, each on its own little track. Beautiful.
guhwinter.npc.praat.niels.oudjaar.1: My resolution: a new train trip every month. A hot air balloon doesn't count. A hot air balloon isn't real public transport.
guhwinter.npc.praat.niels.oudjaar.2: Did you know the first train in the Netherlands ran in 1839? I celebrate that a little every New Year's Eve. Nobody else does.
guhwinter.npc.praat.niels.oudjaar.3: Evi wants to fly to Japan. I found a route with only trains. It takes three weeks. Wahoog!
guhwinter.npc.praat.niels.oudjaar.4: Lin's air fryer is efficient, punctual and reliable. It's basically a good train.
guhwinter.npc.praat.niels.sint.1: A steamboat? Should've just taken the train. A steamboat isn't real public transport.
guhwinter.npc.praat.niels.sint.2: From Spain to here: Intercity to Paris, TGV to Madrid, done. Then you never take a wrong turn at Slot Loevestijn.
guhwinter.npc.praat.niels.sint.3: Ozochonk on a boat. Horses belong on trains. In the luggage car. With a ticket.
guhwinter.npc.praat.niels.sint.4: After pakjesavond Evi and I are off to Japan. On the Shinkansen. Now THAT is public transport, nyeg.
guhwinter.npc.praat.ozovads.sint.3: *shakes his mane and looks very proud* Neigh!
guhwinter.npc.praat.pakjesguh_0.sint.1: Hi! Want a pepernoot? Catch! ...Oops, that one went over the roof.
guhwinter.npc.praat.pakjesguh_0.sint.2: I counted the chimneys. There's one. Saves a lot of climbing.
guhwinter.npc.praat.pakjesguh_0.sint.3: This soot smudge? From the chimney! I wear it with pride. Just a tiny bit.
guhwinter.npc.praat.pakjesguh_1.sint.1: Half the presents went overboard. They're floating around somewhere now. Very festive, but wet.
guhwinter.npc.praat.pakjesguh_1.sint.2: My favourite job? Throwing pepernoten. My second favourite job? Eating pepernoten.
guhwinter.npc.praat.pakjesguh_1.sint.3: I'm pink, I've got a feather on my beret and I can climb any roof. Wahoog!
guhwinter.npc.praat.pakjesguh_2.sint.1: I wrap the presents. Every present gets a bow. That's why they call me Strikje.
guhwinter.npc.praat.pakjesguh_2.sint.2: Ozochonk ran off when we docked. He loves carrots. Really loves carrots.
guhwinter.npc.praat.pakjesguh_2.sint.3: The Big Book is heavier than me. Luckily the Sint is strong. And so is his chair.
guhwinter.npc.praat.pakjesguh_3.sint.1: Hupsakee! From roof to roof! Only allowed with a parcel diploma.
guhwinter.npc.praat.pakjesguh_3.sint.2: On pakjesavond we bang on the door. Really loud. And then we run away really fast. That's how it's done.
guhwinter.npc.praat.pakjesguh_3.sint.3: What I love most? Happy faces. And pepernoten. Happy faces with pepernoten.
guhwinter.npc.praat.rins.kerst.1: Anthony has never done gourmet before. I told him it's 'Dutch barbecue'. He's very nervous about it.
guhwinter.npc.praat.rins.kerst.2: In Guhmerika they eat turkey at Christmas. Here we have sixteen little pans and a grandpa called Wijnand. I know which I prefer.
guhwinter.npc.praat.rins.kerst.3: I drew Anthony and me for the tree. Him with his camera, me with a book. Spot on.
guhwinter.npc.praat.rins.kerst.4: Look at them by the pond, Daan and his little ones. It makes me all soft inside.
guhwinter.npc.praat.rins.oudjaar.1: Anthony is trying to say 'oliebol'. It comes out as 'oily ball'. Which is actually accurate.
guhwinter.npc.praat.rins.oudjaar.2: My resolution: teach Anthony to cycle in the rain. Proper integration.
guhwinter.npc.praat.rins.oudjaar.3: Next year we're spending Christmas in Guhmerika. Anthony's mum wants to know what gourmet is. I'm bringing the set.
guhwinter.npc.praat.rins.oudjaar.4: Happy new year, chonkje. Careful with fireworks. And with Joost near the oliebollen.
guhwinter.npc.praat.rins.sint.1: This is Anthony's first Sinterklaas. He's asked twelve questions already. I could answer three.
guhwinter.npc.praat.rins.sint.2: As the eldest sister I used to make all the surprises for the little ones. Now Daan does it for his. The circle of life.
guhwinter.npc.praat.rins.sint.3: Anthony thinks the steamboat is the best part. I haven't told him the Sint is only here by accident.
guhwinter.npc.praat.rins.sint.4: I wrote a poem for my lootje. It doesn't rhyme at all, but it comes from the heart. Nyeg.
guhwinter.npc.praat.sint.sint.1: Welcome, dear children of... of... This isn't Goringuhm, is it?
guhwinter.npc.praat.sint.sint.2: At Slot Loevestijn left... or was it right? Next year I'll bring a map. Or a Niels.
guhwinter.npc.praat.sint.sint.3: The Big Book knows everything. Who was good, who wants a lootje, and who secretly nibbled the pepernoten. Yes, you.
guhwinter.npc.praat.sint.sint.4: What a warm welcome in this cold Guhmension. I feel at home here, nyeg.
guhwinter.npc.praat.sint.sint.5: My pakjesguhs climb over every roof. They say it's for the presents. I think they just enjoy it.
guhwinter.npc.praat.suus.kerst.1: I hung a bauble in the tree. It happens to look like a ring box. Funny coincidence, right Joost? JOOST?
guhwinter.npc.praat.suus.kerst.2: Christmas always makes me think of big questions. Questions you get down on one knee for. For example.
guhwinter.npc.praat.suus.kerst.3: Gourmet night is just like getting married: you share a little pan and promise not to eat everything. Did I say married? I said gourmet.
guhwinter.npc.praat.suus.kerst.4: Grandpa's name is Wijnand. Joost has been calling him Jochum all day. Joost never knows which finger either... never mind.
guhwinter.npc.praat.suus.oudjaar.1: My good resolution? Patience. Lots. Of. Patience.
guhwinter.npc.praat.suus.oudjaar.2: At midnight you give each other a kiss. And sometimes... something else. Something with a little box. Just an idea.
guhwinter.npc.praat.suus.oudjaar.3: Lin's air fryer oliebollen are the best. Don't tell Joost, he thinks his are.
guhwinter.npc.praat.suus.oudjaar.4: The new year is going to be a very special year. Right? Right, Joost? ...Joost is eating an oliebol.
guhwinter.npc.praat.suus.sint.1: On my wish list I wrote 'something small'. With a little drawing of a circle. Just a circle.
guhwinter.npc.praat.suus.sint.2: Would the Sint also put things in a small box? A velvet one? Asking for a friend.
guhwinter.npc.praat.suus.sint.3: Ten carpaccios in a row at La Cubanita. Joost and I are a good team. The kind of team that... you know... forever... nyeg.
guhwinter.npc.praat.suus.sint.4: My shoe is already out! With a carrot for Ozochonk. And a note for the Sint. About shiny little things.
guhwinter.npc.praat.wijnand.kerst.1: Good day. I'm Grandpa Wijnand. Not Jochum. Wijnand.
guhwinter.npc.praat.wijnand.kerst.2: They said: 'Grandpa, it's in the Guhmension.' I thought that was a village near Goringuhm. I cycled for a long time.
guhwinter.npc.praat.wijnand.kerst.3: Jochum? Who's Jochum? I don't know any Jochum. ...Wijnand.
guhwinter.npc.praat.wijnand.kerst.4: My grandchildren. All so big. And those little ones by the pond are my great-grandchildren. Wahoog, I'm getting old.
guhwinter.npc.praat.wijnand.kerst.5: Gourmet night. In my day that was called: throw everything in one pan. But fine, I'll join in.
guhwinter.npc.praat.wijnand.oudjaar.1: My resolution: that everyone gets my name right this year. Wijnand. W-I-J-N-A-N-D.
guhwinter.npc.praat.wijnand.oudjaar.2: An oliebol out of one of those air-frying things. Never thought I'd eat that. It's delicious. Don't tell anyone.
guhwinter.npc.praat.wijnand.oudjaar.3: When I was young we did carbide shooting on New Year's Eve. Now the grandkids throw powdered sugar around. Also nice.
guhwinter.npc.praat.wijnand.oudjaar.4: Happy new year, chonkje. Just call me Grandpa. Grandpa Wijnand.
guhwinter.npc.praat.winkelguh.kerst.1: Santa hats! They do melt on 3 January, but until then you're the prettiest guh on the square.
guhwinter.npc.praat.winkelguh.kerst.2: Christmas lights for your home! Temporary, like snow. That's exactly what makes them special.
guhwinter.npc.praat.winkelguh.kerst.3: Skates! Faster on the ice. Not faster than Finn though, he's unbeatable.
guhwinter.npc.praat.winkelguh.kerst.4: The shop is busy at Christmas. Well, busy. You're here. That's busy enough.
guhwinter.npc.praat.winkelguh.oudjaar.1: Firework rockets! You can set them off, but carefully. And not in the direction of Grandma Marrie.
guhwinter.npc.praat.winkelguh.oudjaar.2: Everything in my shop is temporary fun. On 3 January it melts away. So enjoy it, chonkje!
guhwinter.npc.praat.winkelguh.oudjaar.3: My resolution: a bigger shop next year. With a corner for air fryers. For Lin.
guhwinter.npc.praat.winkelguh.oudjaar.4: Pepernoten left over? They stay edible, you know. Even in the new year. Pepernoten are forever.
guhwinter.npc.praat.winkelguh.sint.1: Welcome to my little shop! Everything's for sale for pepernoten. Real pepernoten, not buttons.
guhwinter.npc.praat.winkelguh.sint.2: Chocolate letters! I have every letter. Except the Q. Nobody wanted it.
guhwinter.npc.praat.winkelguh.sint.3: Hot chocolate, with whipped cream and a little guh face on top. The face is free.
guhwinter.npc.praat.winkelguh.sint.4: You earn pepernoten with games and by searching the square well. They're everywhere. Really everywhere.
